newsitem.title: TURKEY: Iran, Pakistan and Turkey call for Afghan peace.
newsitem.headline: Iran, Pakistan and Turkey call for Afghan peace.

text.p: Foreign ministers from Iran, Pakistan and Turkey on Sunday called for a ceasefire in Afghanistan during the Moslem holy month of Ramadan.

"The groups in Afghanistan are called upon to agree on a ceasefire in the holy month of Ramadan and begin the peace process," said the statement issued at the end of the meeting in Istanbul. Ramadan starts in the first half of January.
"The problem should be solved by peaceful means and a government formed with the participation of all parties based on the principles of democracy," the statement said.
The three countries have been accused at various times of supporting different sides in the conflict.

The Islamic Taleban movement captured the Afghan capital Kabul in late September from the ousted government of president Burhanuddin Rabbani. Since then it has been fighting against forces loyal to the ousted government and its allies.
